equipment.name: Holy Tome
equipment.availability: rare 8 (Warrior-Priest or Sisters of Sigmar only)
equipment.special: A Warrior-Priest or Sister of Sigmar with a Holy Tome adds +1 to the roll when determining whether a Prayer of Sigmar is cast successfully.

equipment.name: Blessed Water
equipment.special: A single-use thrown weapon with a range of twice the thrower's Strength in inches - roll to hit using Ballistic Skill, with no modifiers for range or movement. Causes 1 automatic wound (no armour save) against Undead, Daemon or Possessed models only; has no effect on anything else. Undead or Possessed models may not use Blessed Water.

equipment.name: Holy Relic
equipment.special: Lets its bearer ignore one failed Leadership test in a game. Owning two or more Holy Relics does not let you ignore a second or subsequent failed test in the same game.

weaponProfile.special: Poison - a natural 6 To Hit automatically wounds the target; cannot cause critical hits. Armour Save modifier is positive (+1) rather than negative - a model that normally saves on 5+ gets 4+ against a blowpipe dart, and even a model with no normal save gets a 6+ save. Stealthy - can fire while hidden without revealing the firer's position; the target may take an Initiative test to try to spot him.
Fire every other turn - a further -3 to the target's Armour Save (70gc for a brace, which fires every turn).

Pair - grants an additional Attack. Climb - +1 Initiative when making Climbing tests. Parry - may re-roll a failed parry attempt once, the same way a sword-and-buckler combination can. Cumbersome - may not use any other weapon for the entire battle.
Pair - grants an additional Attack. Venomous - permanently coated in a poison equivalent to Black Lotus; no additional poison may be applied. Parry - can be used to parry, the same as a sword.

Concussion - a roll of 2-4 (not just 2) is treated as Stunned when rolling on the Injury chart. Holy Weapon - +1 bonus on all to wound rolls against any Possessed or Undead model (a natural 6 is still needed before modifiers to cause a critical hit). Only a Matriarch or Sister Superior may carry two.

Cannot be Parried - a model struck by a steel whip may not parry with a sword or buckler. Whipcrack - the wielder gains +1 Attack the turn they charge, or +1 Attack (usable only against the charger) the turn they are charged; only one whip's Whipcrack bonus applies even if wielding two.

Shoot in Hand-to-Hand Combat - may be fired once in the first round of a hand-to-hand combat, resolved before any blows are struck, at an extra -2 to hit (using Ballistic Skill); this shot is in addition to any close combat attacks. Hand-to-hand - as a pistol, may also be used alongside a close combat weapon for a bonus Attack at Strength 4, resolved once per combat (two Attacks in the first turn of combat if firing a brace).
Thrown Weapon - no penalty for range or moving. Cannot be used in close combat.

equipment.name: Rope and Hook
equipment.special: A model equipped with a rope and hook may re-roll failed Initiative tests when climbing up or down.

equipment.name: Lock Picks
equipment.special: A model equipped with lock picks may make his test to open a locked door using his Initiative rather than his Strength characteristic, with no -1 modifier, and with no chance of the door being damaged beyond repair. General rules price this at 15 gc; the Halfling Thief equipment list prices it at 10 gc, used here since it's the only warband referencing it so far.

equipment.name: Hunting Arrows
equipment.special: A model using a Short Bow, Bow, Long Bow or Elf Bow may use these arrows - they add +1 to all Injury rolls the weapon causes. The core rulebook prices this at a variable 25 + 1D6 gc; this app only supports a flat cost, so it uses the flat 35 gc the Halfling warband list itself prints.

weaponProfile.special: Cutting Edge - an extra -1 save modifier on top of the wielder's Strength-based modifier. Parry - when hit, may roll a D6; a score higher than the opponent's to-hit roll discards that attack, and cannot parry attacks made at double or more the axe's Strength. A model armed with two Dwarf axes (or a Dwarf axe and a sword etc.) does not get to parry two attacks, but may instead re-roll a failed parry.
